title: a-gate-is-a-class
intention: Gates share common code and interface — a gate is a class in node_classes/, not ad-hoc per-ticket logic.
why: Akien, 2026-08-11, stating it as the top priority: 'our top priority is getting all the gates working with common code and config information for each.' And the shape, in his words: 'what is a gate? it should be a class, and we should instantiate a gate and an inspector for each gate... the gate instance hands messages to the harbor master at each transition. that allows the harbor master to recieve that information. the probes are on the gates... i expect it's something like .cairn/devices/device/0/tools/gate/2/probes <- and that is probably in the runtime trees added when the gate instance is constructed.' The lived symptom underneath: today a gate is an inline function inside emit(), so it has no identity — nothing to instantiate per-gate, nothing for a probe to hang on, no config to read, and no way to ask what it has learned. Six gates, six hand-tuned bodies, and every dial in the corpus is a Python literal that no evidence can ever move.
traces_to: I-learns-its-gates (the founding intention, RATIFIED 2026-07-16) — this crystallizes its named child learning-as-a-pattern, and it is the first thing that makes that intention's own third wrong-intent falsifier MEASURABLE. Also Law 4 (a gate that is a class can be inspected, configured and probed; a gate that is an inline function is policy wearing physics' clothes), Law 3 (a gate's dial is an unmeasured claim today), and Law 1 (the sieve/nest/banding primitive is block-general and already landed — re-deriving it per gate is the defect).

falsifier.proves_red: DONE when all four hold, each by its named instrument: (1) all gates instantiate from ONE class with per-gate config — instrument: a census importing the gate registry and reporting zero gate logic left inline in emit(); (2) a dial moves off its seed by installation and the seed-versus-living delta is readable by one command — instrument: that command, run against a moved gate, printing a non-empty field-level diff; (3) the harbor master receives a transition notification and its report shows it — instrument: fire a real crossing, then read harbor_master's report for that crossing; (4) a probe declared on a gate carries an addressee it was never told — instrument: probescan, which today reports the addressee as a copied module-level constant on all 18 probes. HORIZON: the delta in (2) must arise from ordinary work. A delta manufactured by hand-editing the runtime tree to make the instrument fire is the vacuous-fixture failure and does not count.

children: the-gate-is-a-class — one Gate + Inspector class at the block-general level, six named gates instantiating from it, build_inspector as the FIRST TENANT and not the owner (the relation ruling 2026-08-07 already settled one layer down for the nest). Carries the survey question that could split this cast.

a-sieve-declares-itself-in-git — the seed: one JSON file per sieve in class-space beside the gate, named for what it does, carrying the sieve's dials and its band-determining reach. NO order numeric anywhere (decision 2026-08-11-one-mechanism-per-meaning). This is what lets a bare machine regrow a gate.

the-gate-builds-its-own-tree — construction writes ~/.cairn/devices/<device>/0/tools/gate/<name>/ from the seeds, holding the living dials and the gate's probes. Instance-space, never git. Akien's own sketch, with his ratified naming (names, not numbers).

the-rule-and-its-finding-shape-reconcile — the two stamped places, deliberately apart, mismatch flagging that one needs an update. MUST declare its polarity; MUST compose the tester's source_fingerprint/standing() rather than mint a fourth mechanism.

a-gate-tells-the-harbor-master — the notification at each transition, an index and never a rival record. CAST BLOCKED on the receiver-pull, deliberately, so the ordering lives on the ticket instead of in CC's head.

a-probe-takes-its-addressee-from-its-gate — retires the copied to="harbor_master" module-level constant on all 18 probes. Smallest child, and the one that makes probescan's census go green for a reason rather than by coincidence.
how: Build a common Gate + Inspector class at the block-general level. Refactor the six existing ad-hoc gate implementations to use it. Children decompose: the class, sieve declarations, tree construction, finding-shape reconciliation, harbor-master notification, probe addressee.
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(the-seed-versus-living-delta) -> [PROVED]

watchme.trigger: Every construction of a gate instance — the event that already fires. Construction is exactly the moment the seed (git-JSON) and the living tree are both in hand. No clock, no sweep. A gate whose living tree does not yet exist reports delta=SEEDED, which is distinct from delta=NONE (constructed before, never moved).
watchme.enough: When at least one gate reports a NON-EMPTY delta arising from ordinary work — a dial installed as a versioned revision because evidence moved it, not because a hand edited the tree. One real delta answers a falsifier that has stood unmeasurable since 2026-07-16. Enough is ALSO reached in the negative: every gate at delta=NONE after a full pass falsifies the founding claim.
watchme.carrier: A verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying per gate: gate name, seed stamp, living stamp, installed revision id, and the FIELD-LEVEL DIFF. The diff is the payload — a count of changed dials would be the count-instead-of-names failure probescan exists to end.
watchme.nexus: the gate nexus — build_inspector's cairn/machines/build_inspector/nexus.py lifted to the general level alongside the gate class, by the same tenant-not-owner split ruling 2026-08-07 applied to the nest.
watchme.consumer: harbor_master — a REAL consumer only once the receiver-pull lands; named honestly here rather than fictionally, since today it resolves to DiscoveredShim and mail waits. Second consumer: Akien, via the delta command in falsifier instrument (2).

chart_claim: none, because no chart chain was run — backfilled by ticket inspector 2026-08-26. BUILDME entry gate (buildme_rides_the_sorted) is where this is answered or the chain is run.
